claim: § Audio-rate feasibility — and the dissolution: 'Run f once per note and it is an envelope. Run the identical f once per cycle at audio rate and it is an oscillator waveform.'

pieces.what: One curve f(time, curvature) on a scope with a rate knob that slides from one read per second to hundreds; the envelope becomes a pitch without changing the equation.

pieces.section: The straight line is the hard case
pieces.what: Sweep curvature through zero with and without the Taylor branch; hear and see the click at the 0/0 seam vanish.
pieces.walks_up_from: the convex, linear and concave members side by side

pieces.section: Shape is a confound on duration
pieces.what: Three attacks at the same stated time (linear, Moog exponential approach, e^x) played back to back; the reader judges which sounds shortest.

pieces.section: The curve in a synthesizer: the Moog contour
pieces.what: RC charge and comparator switch drawn stage by stage: attack toward the peak, decay toward sustain, release toward zero, with the 95 % landmark marked.

note: The 2026-05-28 teaching artifact is named as unretrieved; the first piece remakes it.
